# unifi_setting_netflow (Resource)

The `unifi_setting_netflow` resource manages NetFlow export settings for a UniFi site, streaming flow records to an external NetFlow collector. When `enabled` is `false`, all other attributes must be omitted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_netflow" "example" {
  # Enable NetFlow export to an external collector.
  # When disabled, none of the fields below may be set.
  enabled = true

  # NetFlow collector endpoint.
  server = "10.0.0.5"
  port   = 2055 # 1-65535

  # Protocol version: 5, 9, or 10.
  version = 9

  # Export and template refresh cadence (seconds).
  export_frequency = 60
  refresh_rate     = 30

  # Flow sampling: off | hash | random | deterministic
  sampling_mode = "hash"
  sampling_rate = 100

  # Engine identification.
  auto_engine_id_enabled = true

  # Networks (by ID) to export flow records for.
  network_ids = [
    unifi_network.lan.id,
  ]

  # Specify the site (optional, defaults to the site configured in the provider, otherwise "default")
  # site = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether NetFlow export is enabled.

### Optional

- `auto_engine_id_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the NetFlow engine ID is assigned automatically.
- `engine_id` (Number) The NetFlow engine ID used to identify the exporter.
- `export_frequency` (Number) How often (in seconds) flow records are exported to the collector.
- `network_ids` (List of String) List of network IDs for which flow records are exported.
- `port` (Number) The UDP port of the NetFlow collector. Valid values: 1-65535.
- `refresh_rate` (Number) How often (in seconds) the NetFlow template is refreshed.
- `sampling_mode` (String) The flow sampling mode. Valid values: `off`, `hash`, `random`, `deterministic`.
- `sampling_rate` (Number) The flow sampling rate (one out of every N packets).
- `server` (String) Hostname or IP address of the NetFlow collector.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `version` (Number) The NetFlow protocol version. Valid values: 5, 9, 10.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
